name: DurationField
description: DurationInput bound to a `number | null` (seconds) form field. Pair it with `durationSchema()`.
signature: ({ label, hint, optional, required, aside, className, disabled, describe, ...control }: DurationFieldProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: aside
props.description: Right side of the label row: a live value readout or a small link.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: clearable
props.description:
Show a clear button while the field has a value. Escape also clears a filled field (and
is then not propagated, so an enclosing dialog stays open); the button itself is a
pointer affordance outside the tab order.

props.name: defaultUnit
props.description: The unit of a bare number ("90" → 90 minutes). Default "m".

props.name: describe
props.description: Spell the value out as the hint when none is given ("1 hour 30 minutes"). Default true.

props.name: hint
props.description: The message line's resting text. Only when the format or consequence is not obvious (R2.8).

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading icon. Pass the icon without a size.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the control. Omit only when a group legend or `aria-label` names it instead.

props.name: onClear
props.description: Called after the clear button or Escape empties the field.

props.name: onRevealedChange
props.description: Called with the new state when the show/hide password button is pressed. Pair with `revealed` to control it.

props.name: optional
props.description: Marks the label "Optional". Prefer this over marking required fields.

props.name: ref
props.description: Receives the underlying element for focus or measurement. React 19 accepts ref as a normal prop.

props.name: required
props.description: Shows the required marker. Pass `required` to the control as well.

props.name: revealed
props.description: Password boxes: whether the value shows as text. Leave unset for the box's own toggle.

props.name: shortcut
props.description: Keyboard hint shown while the field is empty and unfocused ("mod+k" → ⌘K / Ctrl K).

props.name: size
props.description: The token-based size. Touch targets adapt to coarse pointers independently of the selected density.

props.name: trailing
props.description: Any other trailing content (a status, a small action).

props.name: unit
props.description: Unit after the value ("GB", "ms", "%").

props.name: units
props.description: Units written back, largest first (default d, h, m). Seconds below the smallest round.

props.name: warning
props.description: Non-blocking warning in the reserved message slot; errors take precedence.

props.name: width
props.description: Content width: short (port, PIN), medium (name, hostname), full (default).

props.name: children
props.description: The content or component slots rendered inside the component.

props.name: disabled
props.description:
Whether the component should ignore user interaction.
Takes precedence over the `disabled` prop on the `<Field.Control>` component.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: The prompt shown while the value is empty. It does not replace the field’s label.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Displays the current value without allowing edits.

props.name: style
props.description:
Style applied to the element, or a function that
returns a style object based on the component's state.
